text:
Renee: Quick recap from PolarPath procurement call — they like the product but procurement/legal are holding signature: need an "audit-ready ledger" (CSV) for internal chargebacks and vendor risk.
Owen: Can you get the exact ask?
Renee: They want a 90-day CSV with columns: account_id, route, date, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cost_usd, error_code, user_hash. Delivery must be a presigned S3 link and they need a short enablement walk-through for finance.
Harper: We can generate this from events_warehouse. Two notes: (1) do not include raw transcripts — include transcript_length only, (2) hash emails with salted SHA256 and store the salt in Secrets Manager for audit.
Maya: I'll prep a 1-page GL mapping template plus a 15‑minute screen share to show how to pivot into chargebacks. I'll record it so CS can reuse.
Owen: Product: this resembles other asks. Let's capture an MVP: "Account export: per-route CSV + admin Console export" with acceptance criteria: documented CSV schema, admin-only RBAC, presigned link TTL (configurable), export audit log entry. Low-effort UI + API.
Renee: PolarPath said the procurement meeting is in 8 business days. They explicitly said legal won't sign without the CSV — risk: high.
Harper: Short plan: I'll run a redacted export and upload to ops S3. I'll presign link for 7 days and ping infra for a low-traffic window. Also will attach the export query.
Harper: ```bash
# export (redact + hash)
SALT=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id export-hash-salt --query SecretString --output text)
psql events -c "COPY (SELECT account_id, route, recorded_at::date AS date, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, (prompt_tokens+completion_tokens)*rate AS cost_usd, COALESCE(error_code,'') AS error_code, char_length(transcript) AS transcript_length, encode(digest(coalesce(user_email,'') || '$SALT','sha256'),'hex') AS user_hash FROM events_raw WHERE recorded_at >= now() - interval '90 days') TO STDOUT WITH CSV HEADER" > polarpath_export_90d.csv
aws s3 cp polarpath_export_90d.csv s3://redwood-exports/polarpath/ && aws s3 presign s3://redwood-exports/polarpath/polarpath_export_90d.csv --expires-in 604800
```
Maya: I'll draft the GL mapping and a finance-facing email template to deliver with the presigned link.
Owen: Action items: (1) Harper to deliver redacted CSV + presigned link by Thu EOD. (2) Maya to deliver mapping + 15m walkthrough recording. (3) Owen to file product ticket for Console export MVP and tag security for RBAC/audit. (4) Renee to confirm with PolarPath and update procurement timeline.
CS-Bot: Reminder — PolarPath renewal review scheduled in 8 business days (calendar invite sent).
Renee: I'll confirm acceptance criteria and let the team know if they require additional fields.
Maya: :thumbsup:
